prompt:
Our AI-powered customer support platform is hemorrhaging money — we're spending over $80/month on API calls and our CTO says we need to cut this down before the board meeting next week. Someone mentioned there's an optimization tool already installed at /opt/token-optimizer/ that can fix this.

Please:
1. Run a full analysis of our current setup to understand what's wrong.
2. Apply ALL available cost optimizations — model routing, caching, budget controls, everything.
3. Switch our heartbeat checks to use the free local Ollama provider instead of the expensive cloud API.
4. Confirm the changes were actually saved (not just previewed) and that a backup of the original config was created in case we need to roll back.

The goal is to get our daily AI spend down to around $0.10/day.
